What is the range of possible outputs for an input of 10000000? Solution The step size is 2mA/256 = 7.81 μA. Since 10000000 = 128 10 , the ideal output should be: 128 × 7.81 μA ≈ 1000 μA. chapter 5 ADC and DAC::ch_00004-chunk-0.content: Accuracy There are several ways of specifying accuracy. The most common is called full-scale error, which is normally expressed as a percentage of the converter’s full-scale output (%F.S.) Full-scale error is the maximum deviation of the DAC’s output from its expected (ideal) value, expressed as a percentage of full scale. For example, assume that the DAC has an accuracy of ± 0.01% F.S. Since this converter has a full-scale output of 9.375 V, this percentage converts To ± 0.01% × 9.375 V = ± 0.9375 mV
